engine: V8 isolated actual complete old/new replay, helper and original forward observer; test/assert and deterministic digest substitute (NOT Node crypto). Not native Node, live data, whole repo or browser.

unit.name: C15.1 explicit future, reversed, unknown or preclose receipt cannot be replaced with wrapper time
C15.1 explicit suspension, duplicate bar, wrong security, basis and withdrawal cannot become complete path
C15.1 missing individual clocks stay snapshot-only, never invented original time
C15.2 recovered endpoint does not erase earlier close event or actual availability
C15.2 earlier gap prevents certification of first trigger date, but actual later adverse close survives
C15.2 later gap does not erase previously observed event, and no known event is not false risk
C15.3 corporate action invalidates subsequent unadjusted return path, never manufactures a sellable loss
C15.3 before maturity and purged folds cannot certify a complete clear path or leak future labels
C15.3 only every eligible close observed with no adverse event certifies a clear close path
C15.4 same-day co-occurrences are not independent risk trials and missing days stay visible
C15.4 incomplete event remains in unknown denominator rather than clear
C15.5 same paired sample changes labels only, never chooses a new production cutoff
C15.5 absent or malformed paired outcome and invalid neighboring target remain unknown
C15.2 late original receipt separates event date, prefix proof time and earliest available adverse close
C15.5 central label uses exact registered threshold, without rounding it to a different event

integration.name: C15 integration: recovered terminal label and observed intermediate adverse close remain separate

C15 integration: legacy missing clocks leave original descriptive endpoint but path stays unknown

legacy.name: C10.1 original frozen cohort and three policies use exactly the same four holdout labels
C10.1 post-next-open freeze, late input and duplicate security-day are rejected
C10.1 mutation, duplicate packet and mixed feed do not silently enter the same sample
C10.2 absent decision or abstention is not a clear label and reduces paired coverage
C10.2 missing entire frozen day stays a missing population denominator, never zero risk
C10.2 missing, suspended and corporate-action labels stay unknown rather than false negative or normal divergence
C10.2 pending horizons remain unknown before actual target close
C10.3 Brier is computed on identical declared event probabilities only
C10.3 ranking scores, out-of-range probabilities, duplicate opinions and wrong model version cannot become probabilities
C10.3 true zero event/alert denominator stays unknown, never perfect precision or recall
C10.4 tail uses one worst security per complete day, then disjoint windows, not four independent trades
C10.4 small tail sample does not output an apparently precise VaR or ES
C10.4 overlapping horizon windows cannot create independent tail samples
C10.5 preregistration must precede first signal, model training cutoff, immutable plan and same calendar
C10.5 windows overlapping next fold are purged without using their outcomes
C10.5 even passing descriptive criteria never promotes, trains, proves execution or claims actual avoided loss
C10.1 policy opinions bind event, horizon, threshold and plan; source evidence references are retained
C10.1 cohort population and explicitly simulated sources cannot be silently substituted
